title: Guided tour of Granada and the Alhambra
text: I was in Granada in July with my teenage children and we loved the tours we took with Luis, the Alhambra in the morning and the city center in the afternoon. I had been to Granada before and seeing it on your own has nothing to do with going with Luis, who is attentive to every detail and manages to make the tour super interesting and enjoyable. 100% recommended ❤️
author: Ruthls8

title: Hector is the BEST!
text: Fantastic!  Hector was the best guide we have had during our travels.  While his knowledge was incredible, it was his way of conveying it which made the tour more fulfilling.  He would tell great stories to put you in that time period and would engage you in some fun Q&A activities.  Hector was very thoughtful and tried to answer our questions in the most thorough way.  If you schedule this tour, ask for Hector.  He will not disappoint!
author: Keith_K

title: Fantastic!
text: Roberto was a wonderful guide! He communicated with me ahead of time and answered ALL of my questions. We had booked our Alhambra tickets already and just desired a guide so this tour was perfect for our group. Roberto spoke beautiful English and guided us through the Alhambra and gardens providing a wealth of excellent information (much more than if we were on a large group tour). He was not hurried and spent a bit of extra time with us. He was of the most outstanding tour guides we have ever used for any tour we have ever done!
author: Julie_J

title: Great.
text: It was perfect. Luis is a great guide, amenos and professional, and the Alhambra deserves to be visited at least once in his life.
author: Beatriz A

title: 100% recommended
text: The experience of the Tour with Luis in the Alhambra has been amazing! Not only because of the beauty of the place, but thanks to Luis’ explanations we have been able to know its history and imagine what life was like there. We would definitely recommend to take the guided tour with him, we have done it even short. We'll be back for the night, for sure;)
author: leirer2015

title: Visit of 10 in the Alhambra
text: Our tour was a 10 year experience. An essential visit in which our guide was telling us all the details of the Alhambra. I highly recommend it!
author: alejandropL407WW

title: Great Private Tour of Alhambra
text: We are a family of four and had the pleasure of doing a private tour in English of Alhambra with Luís. He was extremely responsive via email and very prompt. Luís was great at guiding us throughout the whole complex explaining all relevant features as well as allowing us time to enjoy the magnificent views! He also guided us after the tour as to where to go to eat in town if we wished. It was a wonderful experience and I would highly recommend Luís!
author: TSH123456

title: The best way to experience Alhambra
text: We had Luis as our guide and it was amazing.  This is the only way to visit the Alhambra without being overwhelmed by the masses of tourists.  Luis gave us great insight, was patient and set a good pace and covered all that we wished to see.  No other way to visit Alhambra - you will not be disappointed.  Thanks Luis!
author: mtjb01

title: Highly detailed and insightful Alhambra Tour
text: Amazing and highly informative tour! Our guide Luis was really knowledgeable and gave us such a comprehensive and detailed overview of the Alhambra. He was very patient and answered all of our questions thoroughly! Would highly recommend!!
author: 432ameenaz

title: Amazing Granada Tour for Schoolchildren
text:
I can only recommend once and a thousand times that you have the services of Luis to know Granada. Our thing was a visit from schoolchildren and we already know that keeping the teenagers’ attention is no easy task. The boys and girls were hooked the whole time and at the end they commented that the tour had been made to him until short. Good storytelling, historical data, curiosities, etc. I will certainly repeat as soon as I can. 
Thanks Luis!
author: carmenbjm99
